status: protocol-only; no official timing run started by the benchmark owner

design.process_isolation: one new subprocess per frozen case, method, mode, and repetition
design.order: rotate method order by case index and repetition; preserve actual run order in every row

modes.cold: one measured public solver call in a fresh process
modes.warm: one unmeasured public solver call followed by one measured call in the same fresh process; no cross-process cache reuse and no cache reuse claim

timing.charged_elapsed_s: parent-child call window around the public solve method; includes method preparation, validation, search, and the solver's route check; excludes process startup and the post-hoc independent checker
timing.process_elapsed_s: fresh subprocess wall time including interpreter/module startup and output collection; diagnostic only
timing.reference_elapsed_s: separate untimed reference pass; never included in a method row's charged time

design.memory: record resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss high-water in bytes for each child; warm mode includes its warm-up and measured invocation
design.caps: retain timeouts, limits, exceptions, child failures, unavailable dependencies, and every other non-success row in place

reference_and_checks.reference: routing.independent.exhaustive(graph, hazard, request), run separately once per case before candidate children
reference_and_checks.oracle_boundary: the core solver is never used as the reference oracle
reference_and_checks.route_check: for any returned legs, run routing.independent.check_route after the charged method interval and retain its full outcome
reference_and_checks.agreement: mechanical tri-state comparison of resolved status/arrival; unresolved reference or method outcomes are null, not disagreements
reference_and_checks.semantic_adjudication: status refinements such as DISCONNECTED versus PROVEN_INFEASIBLE remain visible for independent reviewer/root adjudication

paired_reporting.rule: emit every pair and every case/mode/repetition; report positive time and expansion deltas as regressions, retaining nulls when a row lacks a metric

official_execution.owner: coordinator selects frozen source versions and starts the run
official_execution.restriction: do not run the official benchmark outside the shared exclusive lane; this driver has not been executed with --run

scope.variant_status: none selected in this driver; add one only after coordinator selection and freeze

one_selected_optimization: static legal-suffix edge pruning; generic, not default
legacy_scope: frozen repaired vector component tractable API-compatible exact-addition subset, not full historical eager/SIPP activation arm
selection: after working integration checks; structural reachability, no benchmark outcome tuning
external_watchdog: each subprocess percase wall_s+10 sec; external timeout preserved
freeze: source hashes checked before each child, final fixtures unchanged
